evidence.detail: Exact-v308 class references show rs/l/e/b is constructed and consumed only by rs/l/e/c, the command-console controller/renderer.
Each instance stores a raw String plus creation timestamp and an optional preformatted display String; its sole accessor selects the display override when present and otherwise returns the raw text.

CommandConsole creates entries for submitted commands with System.currentTimeMillis(), formats visible history with the exact 'hh:mm a' timestamp pattern, and also creates '~' sentinel entries for already-formatted console lines.

candidates.note: CommandConsoleEntry is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for one stored command/output line in the exact-v308 command console. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: Client input toggles rs/l/e/c directly on key code 96 (backtick), then diverts typed characters plus left/right cursor editing and up/down history navigation into this class while it is active.

On Enter the class normalizes the command around the exact '::' prefix, invokes the reviewed local ClientCommandProcessor path when available, and otherwise writes exact C2S103 command transport through the client packet stream.
Its render path draws a dedicated 320x100 translucent panel, the exact '>' prompt, blinking '|' cursor, current editable command text, and the stored CommandConsoleEntry history.

The class keeps bounded visible/history lists, supports the exact 'clear' command, timestamps submitted lines with 'hh:mm a', and preserves special yell/news color formatting for rendered console text.
Client, the low-level keyboard path and both game render orchestrators directly consult this instance; the key-remapping plugin also suppresses its own hotkeys while the console is open.

candidates.note: CommandConsole is fixed by direct backtick activation, command editing/history, C2S103/local-command execution and a dedicated rendered console surface. Confidence is 0.999.
